title: BANCO DE DOCENTES - ENSINO SUPERIOR (ENGENHARIA DE SOFTWARE) São Paulo - SP Talent pool
description:
Job description

Olá, somos a Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional!

Nós acreditamos no poder de transformação de vidas por meio da educação de qualidade e excelência! Aqui, buscamos conectar diferentes pessoas para que possam construir um mundo melhor a partir da educação, com muito trabalho, respeito e dedicação, proporcionando a melhor experiência e apoiando a jornada do conhecimento de mais de 390 mil alunos.

A Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional S/A é um dos maiores e mais representativos grupos de educação do país, com instituições de ensino relevantes e marcas reconhecidas em suas regiões, abrangendo desde escolas de ensino básico até instituições de ensino superior.

Docentes e colaboradores de diversas áreas trabalham em sintonia para garantir essa construção diária. Estamos sempre em busca de novas pessoas para colaborar com esse objetivo, seja para uma primeira oportunidade ou profissionais mais experientes.

Se você se identifica com esse propósito e deseja trabalhar em uma de nossas marcas, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Estamos de braços abertos para recebê-lo(a).

Para candidatar-se a uma vaga, mantenha seus dados atualizados e completos. Sinta-se à vontade para se cadastrar em todas as vagas de seu interesse, mas recomendamos concluir um processo antes de iniciar outro.


Main responsibilities

PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES / RESPONSABILIDADES:

  1. Elaborar o plano de aula da disciplina, incluindo conteúdo e metodologia, observando a ementa do plano pedagógico, e submetê-lo à aprovação da Coordenação do Curso.
  2. Ministrar aulas de acordo com o plano de ensino específico para desenvolver a aprendizagem.
  3. Manter atualizado o controle e registro da presença dos alunos em sala de aula.
  4. Avaliar o desempenho dos alunos por meio de instrumentos específicos e acompanhamento pedagógico, garantindo a aquisição das habilidades e competências requeridas.
  5. Preparar, aplicar e corrigir avaliações, devolvendo os resultados aos alunos.
  6. Registrar e publicar os resultados das avaliações, cumprindo o calendário acadêmico.
  7. Manter atualizados os lançamentos no diário de classe.
  8. Seguir o referencial bibliográfico definido pelo Núcleo Docente e indicar alternativas bibliográficas.
  9. Participar de reuniões de colegiado de curso para aprimorar o projeto pedagógico.
  10. Orientar monografias de conclusão de curso, quando indicado.
  11. Manter-se atualizado quanto às práticas pedagógicas.
  12. Participar de atividades de pesquisa e extensão, bem como de comissões e bancas de avaliação, quando solicitado.
  13. Manter produção acadêmica em consonância com as diretrizes do curso.
  14. Participar de eventos científicos para difundir conhecimentos e buscar novas informações.
  15. Reportar à Coordenação do Curso e aos alunos o andamento das atividades pedagógicas e intercorrências.
  16. Participar do Núcleo Docente, quando indicado, cumprindo suas atribuições.
  17. Atualizar-se quanto aos documentos institucionais.
  18. Promover e defender o código de ética da instituição, cumprindo as deliberações dos colegiados e princípios institucionais.
  19. Participar de reuniões departamentais e administrativas, além de reuniões de pesquisa.
  20. Preparar aulas, corrigir provas e trabalhos.
  21. Elaborar projetos para editais de fomento e confeccionar relatórios específicos.
  22. Escrever e revisar artigos, livros e capítulos de livros para publicação.
  23. Preparar resumos e propostas para congressos e eventos científicos.
  24. Participar de bancas de qualificação e defesa de dissertações e teses.
  25. Utilizar recursos institucionais adequadamente, seguindo normas e procedimentos.
  26. Cumprir normas de qualidade, meio ambiente, segurança e medicina do trabalho.

Requirements and skills

Escolaridade: Pós-graduação (Lato Sensu - Especialista, Mestrado ou Doutorado) + cursos de especialização.

Áreas de conhecimento - Engenharia de Software Avançada: Métodos Ágeis, Inteligência Artificial, Aprendizado de Máquina, Análise e Projeto de Sistemas de Informação.

Informática: Pacote Office


Additional information

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Assistência Médica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale transporte
  • Total Pass (Credenciamento com academias)
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Bolsa de graduação/pós-graduação no Grupo Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional

title: Financial Modeling And Investment Analyst
description:
About Us
CELA – Clean Energy Latin America, for 12 years, has been providing financial and strategic advice to companies and investors in the renewable energy and energy transition sector in Latin America.
We are specialists in consulting (strategic, market and regulatory), fundraising, project financing, mergers and acquisitions, in the segments of solar, wind, energy storage and green hydrogen.
For More Information Visit
Position: Financial Modeling and Investment Analyst
Profile
We are looking for an Analyst/Consultant to work in financial modeling and investment analysis related to the energy transition atCELA.The professional must have solid knowledge in financial modeling, project finance and corporate finance, preferably with previous experience in the electricity sector in modeling involving infrastructure, generation and renewable energy projects.
We are looking for someone with proactivity, interest in developing in various topics in the energy sector within a dynamic environment and the ability to work autonomously.
We value professionals committed to the energy transition, who know how to cultivate strategic relationships and contribute to the success of a dynamic and agile consulting team.
Requirements
Degree in Administration, Engineering, Economics or related areas.
Postgraduate degrees and certifications such as CFA will be considered a differential;
Domain of corporate finance, accounting, financial modeling, project finance, valuation;
Minimum experience of 3 years in project modeling and valuation;
  • Fluent English;
  • Previous experience in the electricity sector, renewable energy projects, energy transition, auctions and infrastructure projects will be considered a differential.
Main Responsibilities
Building complex financial models for existing demands and for new technologies in the energy sector;
Valuation, due diligence and feasibility analysis of projects;
Modeling and analysis of optimal capital structure, fundraising via project finance and/or corporate finance, as well as detailed analysis of cost of capital and returns;
Construction and detailed evaluation of sensitivities and scenarios;
Assist the other areas related to CELA's consulting and M&A in the creation of financial modeling and analysis tools when necessary.
Benefits
Remuneration compatible with the market.
To be negotiated depending on the professional's experience;
Health insurance;
Workplace
Mostly home office regime, with the possibility of participating in face-to-face meetings in São Paulo and other locations when necessary.
How To Apply

description:
Job description

Muito prazer,

Nós somos a TIMAC Agro Brasil: maior parceiro tecnológico do produtor que ousa desafiar os limites da produtividade.

Há mais de 20 anos no Brasil, com o propósito de alimentar o mundo, somos uma multinacional francesa que fabrica e comercializa soluções altamente tecnológicas para nutrição das plantas e dos animais.

Pertencemos ao Grupo Roullier, que está presente em todos os continentes, com comercialização em 131 países, 97 plantas industriais e mais de 8500 colaboradores.

Nossas soluções são desenvolvidas por mais de uma centena de pesquisadores junto ao Centro Mundial de Inovação - CMI na França. No Brasil, contamos com três plantas industriais de fertilizantes sólidos nas cidades de Candeias (BA), Santa Luzia do Norte (AL) e Rio Grande (RS), onde também há unidades de produção de fertilizantes líquidos e uma moderna fábrica voltada exclusivamente para nutrição animal.

Comercialmente, cuidamos das lavouras e da produção animal em todos os estados brasileiros através da maior e mais qualificada equipe técnica de campo do Brasil.

O segredo disso? PESSOAS APAIXONADAS pelo que fazem. Portanto, se você é um apaixonado pelo agronegócio, inovação e desafios, junte-se ao nosso time e faça parte do futuro do agro!

- TODAS AS NOSSAS VAGAS SÃO, TAMBÉM, PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA -

A GENTE SE ENCONTRA NO FUTURO DO AGRO!


Main responsibilities

Como Consultor(a) Técnico(a) Comercial, você será responsável por:

  • Visitas diárias ao produtor;
  • Levantamento de necessidades e prestação de serviços;
  • Venda das tecnologias;
  • Coleta de resultados;
  • Relatório de acompanhamento dos resultados do produtor para pós-venda;
  • Gestão da carteira de clientes, através de sistema de relacionamento.

Requirements and skills

Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter:

  • Formação em Técnico Agrícola, Agronomia ou cursos afins;
  • Possuir CNH categoria B;
  • Experiência comercial com vendas de produtos agropecuários;
  • Conhecimento da região de atuação.

This would make you the ideal candidate

Familiarity with CSS preprocessors such as Sass or Less.

Experience with Agile development methodologies.

Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

THIS IS A ON-SITE (NON-REMOTE) JOB AND DEMANDS ENGLISH PROFICIENCY

ESSA É UMA VAGA PRESENCIAL (NÃO-REMOTA) E EXIGE PROFICIÊNCIA EM INGLÊS

Our Game QA Testers are gaming experts who test video games during the initial development stage. Their job is to detect any bugs or glitches in the game before it goes on sale. They are required to complete all stages of a game, explore every map and level, focusing on identifying technical issues within a game, such as glitches, bugs, and inconsistencies.

To be one of our Game QA Testers, you should have in-depth knowledge of video game playthrough, have a real passion for gaming, and a good eye for detail. As a first step in the video game industry, you will be testing different titles on a variety of platforms.

Are you a gamer at heart? Are you a team player and is motivated to learn and grow? This is your opportunity to join the world leading company in video-games testing and contribute to the development lifecycle of some of the most popular games in the world!

No previous experience needed! We will help you learn the basic responsibilities of game testing, including playing multiple AAA games, detecting bugs and glitches, and recommending improvements. Our global team perform functionality and compliance checks on a range of yet-to-be-released games for a variety of platforms including PC, Xbox One, PS5, Switch, VR and mobile and tablet devices.

What you will be doing:

  • Testing games and software to find bugs and following test plans and checklists set by Test Leads to ensure the game functions correctly.
  • Report bugs into tracking database and re-test bugs once they’re fixed by developers by collaborating with colleagues, Senior Testers and Test Leads.
  • Report all glitches and bugs on the platform.
  • Communicating any issues to your Lead and recommending game additions or modifications.
  • Working as part of a global Games QA squad.
  • To love videogames !
  • Advanced proficiency in English (able to read, write, listen and speak ).
  • Availability to work from 10h00 to 19h00 (with 1 hour for lunch), from Mondays to Fridays.
  • 18+ years old
  • Great observational skills and attention to detail.
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft’s office suites.
  • Competitive remuneration.
  • Transportation allowance + Meal Voucher + Medical Assistance + Life Insurance + Private Pension
  • Dynamic, multicultural and fun environment.
  • You will be working for the world's leading provider of game services.
  • A supportive community inclusive of LGBTQ+, and any age, ethnicity, religion, or disability.
  • We care about the wellbeing of our employees and have a dedicated employee wellbeing program.
  • We empower our people and offer regular progression opportunities to ensure our employees flourish.

Who are we?

Side (formally known as PTW)is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in Japan in 1994, Side has grown to become a global force in the video game industry, with over 40 studios in 15 countries worldwide and offices across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include codev, art production, localization, audio production, quality assurance, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets.

Help us bring stories to the world. Join Side's global team of passionate gamers and contribute to top-notch game development. Discover opportunities in Asia, North America, South America, Europe, and beyond.

title: Alliances Field Engineer
description:
1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Alliances Field Engineer to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.
Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.
Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments
  • Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX
  • Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical's technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center
  • Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners
  • Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners' teams to promote Canonical products and solutions
If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.
What we are looking for in you
  • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
  • Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience
What we offer you

About Rain

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We have raised nearly $400M in funding, including the largest Series A in fintech history, and recently closed our Series B to support our next phase of growth.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our innovative and fast-paced team. This role involves designing, deploying, and managing scalable, cloud-native infrastructure to support modern applications. You will work with cutting-edge tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration and deployment within our microservices architecture. If you excel in environments focused on automation, scalability, and observability, this is the role for you.

Required Skills and Experience

  1. Proven experience with Kubernetes in production environments, including deployment and scaling.
  2. Strong expertise in Terraform and Terragrunt for IaC.
  3. Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  4. Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  5. Experience with monitoring tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  6. Familiarity with Helm and secure deployment practices.
  7. Public Cloud certifications in AWS and/or Kubernetes are a plus.

Nice-to-Have Skills

title: Analista de SEO
description:
Quem somos?

Somos uma empresa de produtos de tecnologia corporativa. Temos mais de 15 anos de história e estamos só no começo! Vivemos um forte crescimento no mercado nacional e internacional, sem perder a nossa essência que é conciliar desafios técnicos com um clima leve e colaborativo. Por três anos consecutivos reconhecidos como a melhor empresa de TI para trabalhar do país e há mais de 10 anos estamos entre as melhores empresas do Brasil e da América Latina. Ficamos muito felizes com tanto reconhecimento, o que nos motiva a fazermos ainda mais.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Confira o que é preciso.

  • Experiência em SEO técnico, sendo guiado por dados e otimização;
  • Domínio das tecnologias e ferramentas de SEO (Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs e etc.);
  • Conhecimento dos fatores de ranqueamento nos mecanismos de busca e atualizações de algoritmo;
  • Graduação em Comunicação Social, Publicidade e Propaganda, Jornalismo, Relações Públicas e/ou áreas afins.

O que é desejável, mas não obrigatório?

  • Experiência em empresa de tecnologia;
  • Habilidades em estratégia de mídias pagas;
  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol avançados.

O que você irá fazer no seu dia a dia e com o que irá trabalhar?

  • Analisar, implementar e produzir conteúdo focado em SEO on page e off page;
  • Monitorar e rastrear métricas de desempenho do site, incluindo tráfego orgânico e receita;
  • Realizar pesquisas de palavras-chave para identificar termos relevantes e oportunidades de classificação de páginas;
  • Utilizar tecnologias de IA para otimizar a produção de conteúdo e melhor resultados dos mecanismos de pesquisa;
  • Elaborar estratégias de link building e linkagem interna para melhorar as classificações de pesquisa;
  • Alinhar as iniciativas de SEO aos objetivos do negócio.

Se interessou pela SYDLE e pela oportunidade?

Será incrível receber seu currículo e saber do seu interesse pelo nosso time! Cada currículo recebido é avaliado pelo nosso RH e, caso o seu seja selecionado, entraremos em contato convidando para nossa seleção. Então fique de olho no celular e no e-mail, combinado? Mas caso seu currículo não seja selecionado para essa vaga, não se preocupe! Você ficará automaticamente em nosso banco de talentos para oportunidades futuras.

Conte com a SYDLE!

Nossas oportunidades são para pessoas talentosas, independente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, classe social ou religião. Queremos crescer juntos e acreditamos que, quanto mais diverso e autêntico for o nosso time, mais rico será o nosso dia a dia. Dessa forma, buscamos ter um olhar diferenciado e cuidadoso para essa pauta nas nossas seleções. E, caso você precise de alguma adaptação especial em nosso processo seletivo ou se tiver dificuldades em custear seu deslocamento para participar das avaliações, conte com a gente e informe o RH ao agendar as etapas.

Confira nossos benefícios!

Algumas das nossas opções:

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico da Unimed ou Bradesco com uma série de opções dessas operadoras e você poderá incluir seu cônjuge e filhos;
  • Como os pets também fazem parte da família, temos descontos exclusivos nos planos de saúde animal com a Dog Life e Pet Life;
  • Temos um cartão flexível de benefícios, que você pode usufruir tanto em supermercados, como em restaurantes. Ah, e esse benefício não é suspenso nas férias, para você continuar se alimentando bem;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Acesso ao "Total Pass": uma plataforma com descontos e acesso a academias e estúdios diversos;
  • Você também poderá usar parte do valor do seu pacote de benefícios para fazer aquilo que tiver interesse e for mais conveniente para você, como: academia, algum programa cultural, como ir ao cinema, gasolina, uber, etc.

Além desses, ainda temos:

  • Auxílio à cursos e certificações técnicas;
  • 40 horas semanais e o horário é flexível;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Ausência de dress code;
  • Convênios com restaurantes e outros serviços;
  • Bonificação para indicação de amigos às vagas da SYDLE;
  • Política de PR diferenciada;
  • Sala de integração, com área gourmet, além de um grande espaço aberto pra você relaxar ou trabalhar em um ambiente diferente;
  • Lanches liberados, como frutas, misto quente e outros;
  • Ginástica laboral e blitz de saúde mensais, com temas variados;
  • Atividades coletivas: Vôlei, Futebol, Boxe e Meditação Guiada são algumas das atividades que você poderá se inserir;

  • Além claro, de um clima sem igual, amigável e colaborativo!

ORGANIZATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
Demonstrates leadership in the areas of safety and environment. This requires observing and enforcing safety rules and practices, encouraging safe work behaviors, and promptly correcting conditions and unsafe behavior, which may lead to accidents.
Continually endorse the Quality & Food Safety Policies, assure conformance to all requirements of the Quality & Food Safety Management Systems, & take action to properly report failures of these systems to site management.

Essential Functions

  • Manage all environmental permits and program requirements specific to the site.
  • Lead implementation and management of site ISO 14001 Environmental Management System.

  • Manages, organizes, coordinates and implements all safety and environmental programs and the associated documented procedures to ensure employee and facility safety. Develops and manages tracking systems associated with monitoring performance against site goals.
  • Responsible for overall coordination of safety training within the facility in accordance with pertinent regulations.
  • Advisor to Safety Committee, responsible for coordinating and implementing approved recommendations of this committee.
  • Responsible for following, monitoring and enforcing safety rules, policies and procedures and applying corrective action when necessary. Responsible for developing awareness and promotional programs aimed at operational safety and a safe work environment.
  • Completes safety portion of new hire and contractor orientation.
  • Reports monthly and annual safety statistics to corporate entities.
  • Tracks employee safety training to ensure compliance with regulatory mandates and company policy.
  • Support site management with the investigation of HSE incidents at the site. Where necessary, lead investigation process and/or collaborate with appropriate corporate staff on serious incidents.
  • Communicate HSE incidents and corrective actions in a timely, thorough, and effective manner.
  • Partner with Human Resources to monitor the status of all open Workers Compensation claims and coordinate activities to minimize lost and/or restricted work days.
  • Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) original file and index by entering new and updating SDS when received, copying and distribution of SDS for all departments involved, filing in master book in front offices.
Marginal Functions
  • Writes work orders as necessary.
  • Provides technical information on facility safety and government regulations as they pertain to health and safety to the Rochester site.
  • Recommends policies and procedures ensuring all employees maintain safety and regulatory compliance.
  • Responsible for knowledge and implementation of all upcoming Federal and State legislation relative to safety and ensures informing the various departments of upcoming changes.
  • Attends and participates in the bi-weekly managers operations meeting and daily stand-up meetings.
What You'll Need To Succeed
EDUCATION:Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Safety, Industrial or Environmental Engineering.
EXPERIENCE:
3-5 years experience working in a manufacturing facility preferably in a food manufacturing environment.
In-depth knowledge of HSE regulations, including OSHA, EPA and local requirements.
Knowledge and experience with relevant consensus standards such as NFPA and ANSI, and systems such as ISO 14001.

Nós Somos a PepsiCo!

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse por Melhor! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadores e agentes de mudança.

A oportunidade

Seu Impacto

  • O principal objetivo desta posição é liderar a Área de Frota para garantir o melhor nível de serviço, equilibrando recursos humanos e ativos da frota própria da PepsiCo Alimentos, com as seguintes características (conflitantes entre si):

  • Fornecer à liderança da frota informações sobre a frota gerenciada;

  • Garantir o máximo desempenho integrando as rotas do Brasil, visando otimizar e aumentar a eficiência dos ativos, a sinergia entre todas as regiões e reduzir a quilometragem de veículos sem carga;
  • Minimizar a contratação de frete terceirizado e ampliar a disponibilidade e aderência do frete PEPLOG às demandas da Torre de Controle e do mercado, aumentando a aceitação de cargas de entrada;

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Compreensão e tradução de requisitos: Identificar e priorizar requisitos de negócio, funcionais e técnicos, traduzindo-os em soluções nas plataformas de dados, utilizando as melhores práticas de engenharia de dados.
  • Arquitetura e modelagem de dados: Projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis para armazenar, processar e disponibilizar grandes volumes de dados com alta performance.
  • Integração com Data Science: Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Data Science para projetar e implementar soluções baseadas em dados e Machine Learning.
  • Pipelines e processamento de dados: Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de ingestão, processamento e transformação de dados, garantindo qualidade, eficiência e governança.
  • Orquestração de Pipelines de Dados: Implementar e gerenciar workflows de dados utilizando ferramentas como Apache Airflow, garantindo a automação e escalabilidade dos processos de ingestão e processamento.
  • Melhores Práticas de DataOps: Aplicar conceitos de CI/CD para pipelines de dados, testes automatizados em ETLs, versionamento de dados e monitoramento contínuo da qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Segurança e Governança de Dados: Garantir boas práticas de proteção de dados, controle de acessos, auditoria e conformidade com regulamentos como LGPD e GDPR.
  • Boas práticas e escalabilidade: Atuar como referência técnica na implementação de soluções em nuvem, promovendo as melhores práticas de engenharia de dados, segurança, confiabilidade e escalabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Expertise em SQL: Domínio da linguagem SQL, incluindo melhores práticas, otimização de consultas e modelagem de dados eficiente.
  • Bancos de dados: Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL) e não relacionais (NoSQL), com foco em desempenho e escalabilidade.
  • Programação e notebooks interativos: Experiência com Python e Jupyter Notebooks para análise, processamento e manipulação de dados.
  • Versionamento e colaboração: Conhecimento em sistemas de controle de versão, especialmente Git.
  • Integração e APIs: Familiaridade com consumo e criação de APIs para manipulação e integração de dados.
  • Processamento e análise de dados em larga escala: Conhecimento em Data Warehousing e tecnologias de Big Data para lidar com grandes volumes de dados.
  • Documentação e suporte: Capacidade de criar e manter documentações claras e acessíveis para facilitar o uso dos recursos por outros usuários.

Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras globais de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Qualificações

Disponibilidade para residir em Cuiabá-MT.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Esta oportunidade também é destinada às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro do nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

title: Research Assistant/Research Associate (Fixed Term)
description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic, motivated individual for a position in the group of Professor Alan Warren, Department of Hematology in the Cambridge Institute for Medical Research at the Cambridge Biomedical Campus. You will join an exciting research programme investigating fundamental mechanisms of ribosome assembly, translational control and how defects in these processes drive cancer development. This post will involve the use of cutting edge biochemical, proteomic, next generation sequencing and ribosome foot printing technologies.

This position is available for an immediate appointment. Candidates must either have a PhD in a relevant biological subject or have submitted or about to submit their PhD thesis. Candidates must also have demonstrable expertise in biochemistry, cell biology and/or molecular biology. Relevant post-doctoral experience is desirable. High quality peer-reviewed publications and a keen interest in translational regulation are essential.If you have an excellent background in biological sciences, are prepared to face intellectual challenges and wish to develop your scientific skills, we would like to hear from you. Applicants should have outstanding organisation and communication skills and work well as part of a team.

The Cambridge Institute for Medical Research (CIMR) is located on the Cambridge Biomedical Campus and it is a collaborative institute at the interface between fundamental research and the clinic, with a mission to determine the molecular mechanisms of disease in order to advance human health.

The funding for this position ends on 30th April 2030.

Applicants must have (or be close to obtaining) a PhD.

Appointment at Research Associate level is dependent on having a PhD. Those who have submitted but not yet received their PhD will initially be appointed as a ResearchAssistant (Grade 5, Point 36 £32,546) moving to Research Associate (Grade 7) upon confirmation of your PhD award

Juntar tecnologia + humanização para criar conexões reais e experiências inesquecíveis entre marcas e consumidores. A cada interação, queremos fazer a diferença – enriquecendo vidas e gerando valor para os negócios dos nossos clientes.

Estamos de braços abertos pra te receber!

description:
ADP is hiring a Lead Quality Assurance Automation – Lyric Team

You will start your day with a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goals with your team. Most of your day will be spent continuously evaluating existing test coverage, identifying gaps, and implementing test strategies to maximize confidence in automation and ensure product quality. Your role also involves advocating for necessary changes to improve the end-user experience.

In this role, you will collaborate with the development team and Product Owner to gather details on features to develop and use that information to build and execute product testing for ADP's web-based Human Resources solutions, ensuring usability before deployment. This role is critical to ensuring we deploy usable products.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience in:

  • Quality Assurance Analyst / Test Engineer
  • Selenium
  • Test Automation
  • Java, JavaScript/TypeScript
  • BDD/Cucumber
  • Jenkins
  • Writing Test Scenarios
  • Using API testing
  • Testing web UI and API applications
  • Working with Continuous Integration processes and tools like Jenkins

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Agile. You understand that an agile environment requires flexibility. Sometimes the scope is not fully defined, and you'll need to communicate with the Product Owner and team to gather more details and refine User Stories. You and the team will define the sprint goal together. Working in two-week sprints, you need to adhere to timelines. Due to time constraints and work fluidity, you may need to take a creative approach to testing strategies. Starting test development in parallel with feature development may be an option.
  • Create & Test. You'll define test plans and scenarios and implement automated test cases for large-scale, complex software applications, focusing on verification and validation from a system and end-user perspective.
  • Collaborate. You will communicate and collaborate with developers and stakeholders, articulating clear reasons to persuade for product improvements benefiting the end user.
  • Learning. You are eager to learn new coding skills and figure things out as you go.
  • Challenges. You will encounter challenges and will be expected to find solutions.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

*The work model adopted by ADP is office-based/presential, with the possibility of up to two days of remote work per week.

Considering the activities involved in this role require access to highly confidential and sensitive information of ADP's clients and their employees, ADP reserves the right to conduct background checks periodically, as authorized by the Repetitive Resource Appeal nº 01 of the Superior Labor Court, with the candidate's/trabajador's consent.

title: Consultor Seguranca de Processos
description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras globais de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos, guiados por nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho, incluindo ética, integridade, humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  1. Liderar o Processo de Implementação da Política de Segurança dos Processos na CIA

Desenvolver planos de implementação para atender aos padrões do programa PSP 2.0, incluindo:

  • Conformidade com o PSM da OSHA (29 CFR 1910.119);
  • Regulamentações locais de PSM + LDC PSP 2.0 para a prevenção de acidentes graves (eventos de magnitude significativa, como incêndios, explosões, derramamentos que podem causar fatalidades, impactar a mídia ou a reputação da empresa).

Garantir que as informações de segurança do processo (P&IDs, normas técnicas) sejam mantidas atualizadas, bem como as PHAs e suas conexões lógicas com o restante dos elementos do PSM e a tecnologia necessária para garantir operações seguras.

Fornecer suporte direto aos locais de fabricação sobre questões operacionais, sistemas ambientais e melhores práticas para implementação.

Qualificações

  • Graduação em engenharia ou áreas afins, com pós-graduação em Segurança de Processos.
  • Familiaridade com estudos de análise de riscos de processos (PHA), técnicas de gerenciamento de projetos, revisões pré-embarque (PSSR), gerenciamento de mudanças (MOC) e gerenciamento de contratados.
  • Conhecimento de planejamento, atividades de design, engenharia de projetos, operações e manutenção. Fluência em inglês. Conhecimento em softwares de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Experiência com instalações industriais com risco químico, gerenciamento de poeira em cereais, gás e petróleo ou riscos equivalentes, preferencialmente com foco na aplicação de um programa PSM.

Informações adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Esta oportunidade também é destinada a pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro do nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados por criar valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para os stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nossos colaboradores, parceiros comerciais, comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

description:

Location: BAL - SEDE

Requisition Number: 36991

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for Sr. Analyst, Governance, Risk and Compliance. In this role, you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology, and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster, and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world-class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people don’t just come here to work; they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.

Overview

As a GRC Sr Analyst – Policy Governance, you will be a key player in developing, implementing, and maintaining organizational governance frameworks and policies. You'll ensure compliance with internal regulations and external requirements, mitigate risks, and facilitate informed decision-making. This role requires a deep understanding of policy development, compliance monitoring, risk assessment, and stakeholder management. You will be a crucial part of ensuring the organization operates ethically, efficiently, and in accordance with best practices.

Essential Functions

  • Develop, implement, and maintain organizational governance frameworks and policies.
  • Develop metrics based on policies and standards.
  • Conduct regular reviews and updates of existing policies to ensure relevance and effectiveness.
  • Oversee policy development, monitor compliance, and maintain governance structures.
  • Facilitate decision-making processes related to governance and policy.
  • Conduct risk assessments for policy development and document mitigation strategies.
  • Provide guidance to project managers and teams on compliance matters.
  • Manage and distribute internal regulations such as policies, standards, and work procedures.
  • Assist staff with locating and interpreting organizational policies and procedures.
  • Support the governance process and policy development.
  • Communicate with the leadership team.
  • Identify and deliver opportunities for policy alignment, coordination, and collaboration.
  • Engage with the policy environment and persuade policymakers on the importance of various considerations.
  • Lead input to major policy and strategic projects from design to implementation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
  • 2+ years of work-related administrative experience.
  • Experience in policy development, implementation, and compliance monitoring.
  • Knowledge of governance frameworks, risk management, and compliance best practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with online governance systems is a plus.
  • English fluent or in advanced level.

Bunge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, national origin, citizenship, age, disability or military or veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Competitive Intelligence Specialist
description:
The Competitive Intelligence Specialist is part of the sales team. Be prepared to work with the sales force to help win the deal. You will be THE expert on your competitor(s) and solely responsible for all insights and understanding of a competitor set and that responsibility does not end with educating the sales force on the competitor. You need to be prepared to present NetSuite vs. competitor X to our prospect, our partners and our systems integrators. You will be asked to compare our product with our competitor and answer deep functional differentiator questions. You will develop client-facing content and travel to client, prospect, partner and systems integrator meetings to add your knowledge and insight. While you will be building reusable content, the focus of this role is in support of deals which includes being comfortable with prospect and customer facing meetings and events.

You are also responsible for a vertical or horizontal business unit's market, competitor and customer insight needs. This includes providing insight support by using all primary and secondary resources available. You are considered a member of the sales force you support and will regularly be asked to participate in staff meetings, group sessions, deal reviews, partner interactions and client-facing competitor reviews. You own the win/loss review process and that includes interviewing the prospects and customers on why we won/lost and bringing that knowledge to bear in future sales cycles.

To do this you should have mastered all standard secondary resource tools and must be adept at engaging in primary research utilizing proven, validated research techniques. You will be seen as an expert in your area of responsibility and will regularly be asked for recommendations or opinions.

Career Level - IC4

Responsibilities

  1. Sales Lifecycle skills: Engages throughout the entire lifecycle of the deal from the initial “attract” phase through “close” providing content, collateral, talking points, FUD, traps, win themes, differentiators, and pricing strategy to beat the competitor. Support can take many forms including coaching the sales force to presenting directly to the prospect.
  2. Insight Generation skills: Proactively seeks additional analyses to flesh out findings. Integrates interesting patterns into a cohesive story. Maintains relationships with SMEs within the company and outside who can help with insight generation. Consistently informs research recommendations with a personal point of view. Uses professional experience to develop their own and their colleague’s recommendations. Consistently develops compelling "so what’s" and actionable "now what’s" for the business.
  3. Business problem solving skills: Reframes requests to maximize their value even when the requests come from difficult constituents. Continues the scoping conversation throughout the project process to test interim findings/insights with the business partner. Is recognized by senior business partners for possessing exceptional business acumen and is proactively sought for advice. Captures opportunities to influence business decisions and strategies consistently.
  4. Influencing skills: Focuses on relationship building as well as using strong scoping tools to uncover the problem even when not clearly articulated. Encourages debate around research recommendations and consistently advocates for their point of view.
  5. Communication skills: Capable of presenting point of view. Owns the building and constant updating of relationship maps to understand the appropriate constituents to focus on. Creates presentations that focus on the insights that are clearly articulated with supporting data where appropriate. Leverages knowledge management tools or research communications to share insights broadly across the organization, with a particular focus on vertical and industry communities. Considers communication preferences and decision maker needs to tailor recommendation communication across audiences. Presents at Voice of the Analyst events (when applicable) and/or other meetings.
  6. Synthesis skills: Takes ownership for stewarding the research team's knowledge base by continuously maintaining platforms on KM and/or collaboration platforms and other loci of knowledge. Works with business partners to compile current knowledge and identifies gaps that they need filled in order to make better decisions. Considered a valuable team member outside the research organization for their ability to compile and make sense of diverse data.
  7. Foundational skills: Seeks information on new techniques through conferences or other learning sources. Proposes new/different research techniques. Actively seeks out training in emerging methods and techniques. Seeks out sources and learning events to grow business acumen and industry knowledge.

  • Generate Engineering Change Notices (ECN’s).
  • Create and maintain project files using departmental resources and best practices.
  • Conduct model design reviews with both internal resources as well as externally with customers and project management.

title: Accounting Associate
description:
Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for an Accounting Associate!

Note to Applicants:

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounting Associate to join our growing offshore team. The ideal candidate will assist in managing financial records, processing transactions, and supporting accounting functions to ensure smooth financial operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Accounts Payable:
    • The associate would be responsible for managing client email inboxes, including vendor information, responding to vendor emails, and coding invoices in the client’s accounts payable software daily. They would also prepare AP run files weekly.
  • Accounts Receivable:
    • Depending on the client, the associate would be responsible for preparing customer emails, sending collection follow-up emails, and preparing AR aging summaries.
  • Month End Close:
    • The associate will be working on 5-7 clients depending on their size, preparing month-end tasks concurrently during the first 10-15 business days of the month.
    • Tasks include bank and credit card reconciliations, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, accounts payable and receivable reconciliations. As they gain experience, tasks can evolve in complexity, including payroll, accruals, revenue, and preparing financial statement packages and flux analysis.
  • Audit / Tax Requests:
    • As clients file annual tax returns or grow to need audits, associates will assist in preparing schedules needed to support these processes.

Requirements:

  • Strong preference for a degree in Accounting, with Finance or related fields being secondary.
  • If they have a degree in a related field, an accounting certification would be a plus.

Must Haves:

  • Full professional proficiency, both spoken and written. Effective communication is imperative.
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in an accounting or bookkeeping role, preferably with a US-based company.
  • Experience preparing bank reconciliations, fixed assets, prepaid expenses, etc.
  • Experience with Quickbooks Online is a large bonus.

Nice to Haves:

  • Work experience at one of the big four US accounting firms (KPMG, PricewaterhouseCoopers, Deloitte, Ernst & Young).
  • Ability to create or improve processes in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Experience in Netsuite, Bill.com and/or Ramp.

Work Schedule:

Typically, the associate’s schedule would be 9AM - 6PM EST, with flexibility to shift that window an hour either way.

Perks:

  • Competitive USD compensation.
  • PTO Policy in addition to US Holiday Schedule.
  • Opportunity to work in a dynamic and growing company.
  • Positive and collaborative work environment.

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

description:

  • Utilizar ferramentas e scripts para automatizar a implantação de aplicações, monitoramento, backup e recuperação. Implementar integração contínua (CI) e entrega contínua (CD) usando ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou CircleCI;
  • Facilitar a colaboração entre desenvolvedores, operações de TI e outros profissionais, coordenando esforços para garantir a entrega rápida e confiável dos serviços;

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES INDISPENSÁVEIS:

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada;
  • Conhecimento em scripts e automação (Python, Bash, etc.);
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation);;
  • Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

  • Implementação de Infraestrutura: Projetar, implementar e gerenciar a infraestrutura de TI usando ferramentas de automação como Terraform, Ansible, ou CloudFormation;
  • Conhecimento avançado de redes e segurança;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança DevOps (DevSecOps).
  • Experiência em projetos de grande escala e ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

title: Application Change Management System Engineer
description:
Position Description Summary:
O Application Change Management System Engineer é responsável pela integridade geral do sistema e pela coordenação com outras equipes de suporte de TI para gerenciar mudanças nos sistemas dentro do escopo. Isso se aplica principalmente, mas não se limita, a sistemas SAP.

Detailed Description and Tasks Performed:
Este cargo inclui, mas não se limita, às seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Suporte à gestão de mudanças Follow The Sun (FTS) para todos os sistemas SAP, incluindo atividades de congelamento de mudanças e janelas de migração para o ambiente produtivo, atualizações SAP e atividades de atualização do sistema.
  • Uso de Solution Manager, SAP Change Request Management (ChaRM), Focused Build e SAP Transport Management System (STMS) para mover mudanças de aplicação através de mais de 30 ambientes de 3 camadas, bem como ambientes N+1.
  • Participação em uma equipe Ágil global.
  • Implementação e manutenção de controles de gestão de mudanças dentro dos sistemas SAP para garantir a integridade/disponibilidade do sistema.
  • Resolução de incidentes e problemas relacionados à gestão de mudanças em todos os ambientes SAP.
    Comunicação global diária com um grande número de equipes de processo e técnica.
  • Identificação e aproveitamento de oportunidades para tornar o suporte mais eficiente dentro das equipes.
  • Ponto de contato principal para equipes de processo, equipes técnicas e equipes de projeto na programação de mudanças para projetos e pequenas tarefas de trabalho, auxiliando na gestão de mudanças.
  • Disponibilidade para suporte fora do horário comercial (on-call), com cobertura de 3 regiões geográficas e suporte limitado nos finais de semana.
  • Participação no processo de recuperação de desastres (Disaster Recovery).

Estamos construindo um futuro mais sustentável através da mobilidade!

Na CAF Brasil, temos orgulho em trazer qualidade, segurança, alta tecnologia e sustentabilidade à nossa sociedade, por meio da fabricação e manutenção de trens para transporte de pessoas.

Através de diversas equipes, nosso trabalho de escritório se dedica a apoiar o negócio, criando e gerenciando processos que garantam o bom funcionamento organizacional. title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Your dream job! Customer Support at fun WordPress Startup

Do you dream of working for a startup that will help millions of people?

Do you have the heart of a teacher?

As a Customer Support (also known as “Happiness Engineer”) you will be responsible for keeping the wheels of a growing startup turning!

To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

  1. You’re a Google Spreadsheet wizard.
  2. You’re amazing at following directions.
  3. You’re passionate about research and helping people.
  4. You’re incredibly organized and detailed.
  5. You’re positive and enjoy making another person’s day.
  6. You’re an excellent communicator who makes sure nothing slips through the cracks.
  7. You’re a self-starter who loves taking initiative and seeing things through to completion.
  8. You have the curiosity and desire to learn and grow your skills.
  9. You take pride in the quality and craftsmanship of your work rather than just doing it to get it done.
  10. You have prior WordPress experience and understand how plugins work, plugin and theme troubleshooting, etc.
  11. You are a linguistic legend with a command of the English language so strong it would make Shakespeare bow down in awe.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You are the bridge between ApproveMe.com and our users. You are responsible for sales questions, general technical support, helping our users get to know the ins and outs of ApproveMe.com’s WP E-Signature plugin, and facilitating other tasks that are billing, user, or site-related.

Full Time or Part Time, we're searching for individual freelance contractors that are available for both. Our support team is a critical component of our organization, engaging with customers and potential customers each and every day.

We're searching for individuals who are long-time WordPress users who additionally know how to get their hands dirty when it comes to basic troubleshooting WordPress sites, and of course creating and customizing WordPress plugins and themes (bonus).

Self-starters that are independent, have incredible people skills, and are fluent in English are a requirement. Bar-tending or restaurant experience = bonus points. They make great support agents!

WHAT WE OFFER

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here’s what we offer:

  1. Competitive Local Salary.
  2. Work from your home. We’re spread out all over the world – the United States, Ireland, Bangladesh, India, Indonesia and more.
  3. We happily provide or reimburse software you’ll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
  4. We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
  5. Custom branded laptop at your five-year anniversary.
  6. Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
  7. And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

LOCATION

This is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Arizona, USA, so company operating hours are Monday - Friday, 8 am - 5 pm MST (UTC -7). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day if we need to sync up in real-time before you work on your project/tasks.

REQUIREMENTS

  1. Personal Computer with (reliable) Internet Access.
  2. Availability to participate in (bi-weekly) audio/video meetings between the hours 8 am - 5 pm PST.
  3. Available for 40+ hours per week (this is a full-time position).

HOW TO APPLY

If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!

Please clearly include the following in your cover letter:

Tell us a bit about yourself and why you should be considered. Include any details about your experience, qualifications, personality, etc. that are relevant to the job posting.
We won’t be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you’re a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly. Qualified candidates may be asked to complete a test assignment.

Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

ABOUT APPROVEME.COM

ApproveMe.com is a startup located in Phoenix, AZ. Our product WPESign transforms a WordPress powered website into a legally binding, court recognized document signing application. We’ve been collaborating with some of the most successful designers and startup founders in the world to create a new product that will literally change how the electronic signature industry approaches signing documents forever.

description:

Join to apply for the Coordenador(a) de Prevenção de Perdas role at Coop - Consumer Cooperative

A Coop Cooperativa de Consumo está buscando um(a) Coordenador(a) de Prevenção de Perdas para se juntar à nossa equipe. Como a maior Cooperativa de Consumo da América Latina, a Coop preza pela excelência no atendimento ao cliente e pela eficiência em nossas operações. Estamos à procura de um profissional que compartilhe desses valores e esteja disposto a contribuir para o sucesso de nossa empresa.
Principais Atribuições

  • Assegurar a execução dos procedimentos e ações de prevenção de perdas e gestão de riscos, propondo inclusive melhorias de processos, identificando a causa raiz, com foco na prevenção e inibição de erros operacionais, financeiros, desvios, avarias e fraudes;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento dos índices de perdas, as metas da área, criar planos de ação e integrar as áreas envolvidas, por meio de relatórios gerenciais e apresentações, com o intuito de melhorar os resultados financeiros e operacionais da Coop, apoiando na implementação e o cumprimento dos planos de correção de não-conformidades identificadas nas auditorias;
  • Coordenar e executar os inventários rotativos diários de estoque, visando o tratamento das ocorrências, a acuracidade dos dados, a redução da perda de fornecimento por ruptura, vencimento e ajuste de estoque no sistema conforme físico e monitoramento dos registros e motivos de perdas, bem como acompanhar e garantir a realização dos inventários gerais;
  • Garantir a execução das auditorias rotineiras e amostrais, por meio da análise de indicadores, acompanhamento da execução de procedimentos / políticas e registros incorretos nas diversas áreas envolvidas nas perdas, identificando e corrigindo não conformidades através de planos de ação específicos para mitigação das inconsistências apuradas e verificando a existência de procedimentos para todas as atividades pertinentes;
  • Coordenar e alinhar com todas as áreas envolvidas o plano de ação de Prevenção de Perdas definido pela empresa, garantindo a devida aplicabilidade, por meio de reunião de performance, revisitação constante dos modelos de trabalho e divulgação dos indicadores sem sobreposição, com um papel ativo na disseminação da Cultura de Prevenção de Perdas e garantia da Eficiência Operacional.
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Especialização em Prevenção de Perdas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com rotinas de Prevenção de Perdas em CD Logístico;
  • Conhecimentos em pacote office e SAP.
Benefícios
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • 5% de desconto em compras nos supermercados;
  • 50% de desconto em compras nas drogarias (mediante apresentação de receita em nome do colaborador);
  • Totalpass;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Cesta de natal;
  • PPR (participação nos resultados).
Jornada e Horário De Trabalho

Local De Trabalho e Modalidade

title: Subtitling Project Coordinator
description:
Join to apply for the Subtitling Project Coordinator role at Keywords Studios .

Keywords Studios Los Angeles is a premier provider of multimedia content localization and audio production services. From its offices and beautiful on-site recording studio in the heart of Burbank, Keywords Studios Los Angeles collaborates with top-tier streaming platforms, broadcasters, content creators, and publishers in the gaming and media & entertainment industries.

We are seeking Subtitling Project Coordinators to join our Media & Entertainment division. In this role, you will work closely with client tools, workflows, and teams to ensure seamless management of multilingual localization projects. The ideal candidate will excel in file delivery management, overseeing the handoff and delivery of multiple projects of varying scales, all while meeting client deadlines. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for delivering exceptional localization solutions, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure that projects assigned by clients are delivered within the agreed timescales, meeting quality standards and company profitability margins.
  • Manage internal and external resources to perform according to project instructions, client expectations, and QA procedures.
  • Prepare and analyze translation files from clients.
  • Maintain accurate, updated, and complete project data in the company's system.
  • Prepare essential data for client invoicing and financial reports.
  • Participate in regular internal meetings.

Requirements:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience in localization and/or the video game industry is preferred.
  • Outstanding attention to detail.
  • Motivated team player.
  • Reliable and punctual.
  • Proficiency in PC and MS Office products.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Passion for gaming.

Additional benefits include a competitive salary, projects aligned with your expertise, opportunities to collaborate on AAA titles, professional growth, diversity and inclusion initiatives, and perks such as cycle-to-work schemes, IT benefits, pensions, healthcare, and social events.

Our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) Commitment: Keywords Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. We welcome candidates from underrepresented groups and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment.

title: CONSULTOR(A) TÉCNICO(A) COMERCIAL - ARAÇATUBA/SP (PRODUÇÃO ANIMAL)
description:
Job description

Muito prazer,

Nós somos a TIMAC Agro Brasil: maior parceiro tecnológico do produtor que ousa desafiar os limites da produtividade.

Há mais de 20 anos no Brasil, com o propósito de alimentar o mundo, somos uma multinacional francesa que fabrica e comercializa soluções altamente tecnológicas para nutrição das plantas e dos animais.

Pertencemos ao Grupo Roullier, que está presente em todos os continentes, com comercialização em 131 países, 97 plantas industriais e mais de 8500 colaboradores.

Nossas soluções são desenvolvidas por mais de uma centena de pesquisadores junto ao Centro Mundial de Inovação - CMI na França. No Brasil, contamos com três plantas industriais de fertilizantes sólidos nas cidades de Candeias (BA), Santa Luzia do Norte (AL) e em Rio Grande (RS), na qual também está unidade de produção de fertilizantes líquidos e uma moderna fábrica voltada exclusivamente para nutrição animal.

Comercialmente, cuidamos das lavouras e da produção animal em todos os estados brasileiros através da maior e mais qualificada equipe técnica a campo do Brasil.

O segredo disso? PESSOAS APAIXONADAS pelo que fazem. Portanto, se você é um apaixonado pelo agronegócio, inovação e desafios, junte-se ao nosso time e faça parte do futuro do agro!

-TODAS AS NOSSAS VAGAS SÃO, TAMBÉM, PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA -

A GENTE SE ENCONTRA NO FUTURO DO AGRO!


Main responsibilities

Como CONSULTOR(A) TÉCNICO(A) COMERCIAL você vai ser responsável por:

  • Atender e gerir carteira de clientes;
  • Visitas diárias ao produtor;
  • Vendas das tecnologias;
  • Realizar levantamento de necessidades;
  • Acompanhar e analisar os resultados junto aos produtores;
  • Elaborar relatórios de acompanhamento técnico (ferramenta ACT);
  • Dias de campo e palestra.

Requirements and skills

Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter:

  • Formação técnica ou superior em Agronomia, Agropecuária, Zootecnia, Veterinária ou cursos afins;
  • Experiência comercial no Agronegócio;
  • Possuir CNH categoria B;
  • Conhecimento da região de atuação.

Additional information

Confira todos os benefícios e ferramentas de trabalho que oferecemos:

  • Remuneração fixa e variável (comissões);
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • TotalPass (academias e estúdios);
  • Veículo + cartão combustível;
  • Celular;
  • Tablet.

title: Analista Comercial Junior
description:
O Analista Comercial é um profissional que trabalha no suporte às operações comerciais, ajudando a equipe comercial a alcançar os objetivos da empresa. Sua principal função é analisar e processar dados, gerenciar informações sobre o mercado e clientes, além de fornecer suporte estratégico para a tomada de decisões dentro da área comercial. Esse cargo exige habilidades analíticas, organizacionais e de comunicação, além de um bom entendimento dos processos comerciais.
Principais responsabilidades:

  • Análise de Mercado e Desempenho Comercial:
    • Coletar, processar e analisar dados de vendas, tendências de mercado, concorrência e comportamento dos clientes.
    • Gerar relatórios periódicos para monitorar o desempenho das vendas, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e sugerir ações estratégicas.
    • Realizar a análise de indicadores comerciais (KPIs), como taxa de conversão, ticket médio, ciclo de vendas, entre outros.
  • Suporte na Planejamento Comercial:
    • Apoiar na elaboração de planos e estratégias comerciais, colaborando com as equipes de vendas e marketing.
    • Ajudar a definir metas de vendas, estratégias de precificação e segmentação de mercado.
    • Acompanhar a execução das estratégias e reportar resultados e desvios aos gestores.
  • Gestão de Relacionamento com Clientes:
    • Apoiar a equipe comercial na identificação de clientes potenciais e manter o banco de dados de clientes atualizado.
    • Auxiliar na manutenção do relacionamento com os clientes através de ferramentas de CRM (Customer Relationship Management).
    • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de propostas comerciais e no processo de negociação.
  • Processamento e Controle de Pedidos e Contratos:
    • Ajudar na elaboração e controle de pedidos de vendas, contratos e orçamentos, garantindo que os processos sejam feitos corretamente.
    • Monitorar o andamento dos pedidos e garantir que as entregas e o processo de faturamento sejam realizados de maneira eficiente.
  • Monitoramento de Competência e Mercado:
    • Realizar pesquisas sobre as tendências do mercado, comportamento dos consumidores e concorrência para fornecer informações cruciais à estratégia comercial.
    • Auxiliar na análise da performance de produtos e serviços da empresa em comparação com os oferecidos pelos concorrentes.
  • Apoio à Equipe Comercial:
    • Fornecer suporte operacional à equipe de vendas, seja com informações sobre clientes, produtos, preços ou demais dados necessários para a prospecção de novos negócios.
    • Preparar apresentações comerciais e materiais de apoio para reuniões com clientes ou reuniões internas.

From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the Bid Manager in São Paulo we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in bids and signalling systems to a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and goal-oriented teammates.

You'll play a key role in driving successful bid management processes, ensuring alignment with customer expectations and Alstom’s strategic goals. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, finance, legal, and procurement), manage risk assessments, and ensure adherence to deadlines, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of leading national and international bids and developing strategies for the transportation and information markets, but also liaise with multicultural and matrix teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

We’ll look to you for:

  • Managing bids for signalling systems in the rail market

  • Ensuring alignment with customer expectations, technology breakthroughs, and competitive landscapes

  • Driving financial results and ensuring cost-effective solutions

  • Conducting risk analysis (financial, legal, and political) and implementing mitigation strategies

  • Collaborating with internal and external partners to motivate and achieve results

  • Ensuring adherence to deadlines while maintaining quality and rigor


All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

  • Engineering Degree (Master equivalent or above) in Telecom, Electrical, Electronics, or Automation

  • More than 8 years of experience as a bid manager

  • Experience in signalling systems within the rail market

  • Knowledge of transportation and information markets, including customer expectations and business models

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills

  • Experience in risk analysis methods

  • Understanding of technical/engineering issues, contracting, finance, and product specifications

  • Fluency in English; Spanish advanced

  • Effective active listening, communication, and negotiation skills

  • Ability to work in a multi-cultural and matrix organization

  • Focus on simple solutions to complex problems

  • Strong process orientation and financial result-driven mindset


Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

  • Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career

  • Work with advanced security standards for rail signalling

  • Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues

  • Contribute to innovative projects

  • Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment

  • Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries

  • Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning

  • Progress towards senior leadership roles

  • Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Senior brand designer analyst
description:
About Azion

We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!

At Azion you will have the opportunity to develop and be connected to cutting-edge technology, immersed in a culture centered on innovation and a high-performance team, unlocking new possibilities and working with the future of technology.

About the position

We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Brand Designer Analyst to join our marketing team. As a technical B2B company, we need someone who understands how to communicate complex ideas visually, shaping and evolving our brand identity to resonate with developers, enterprise customers, and industry leaders. You will be key in crafting compelling brand experiences across digital and physical touchpoints, ensuring brand consistency while driving engagement and awareness.

Main challenges

  • Lead and evolve Azions brand identity, ensuring a cohesive and compelling visual presence across all channels;
  • Design assets for events, presentations, websites, whitepapers, blogs, digital ads, and marketing campaigns, maintaining high design excellence;
  • Collaborate closely with product marketing, product, content, and demand generation teams to create impactful visual storytelling;
  • Oversee the design and execution of branded materials for industry conferences, webinars, and customer events;
  • Work with external agencies and freelancers when needed to scale design efforts.

Ideal Profile

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into visually engaging designs;
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions;
  • A self-starter with strong time management skills and attention to detail.

Requirements

  • Consolidated experience in brand design, ideally within a B2B technology or SaaS environment;
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, color theory, and composition;
  • A strong portfolio showcasing brand identity, digital campaigns, event design, and presentation design;
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects), and other industry-standard design tools;
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including marketers, developers, and external vendors;
  • Experience designing for web, digital advertising, events and social media.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience in motion design and video editing;
  • Familiarity with HTML/CSS is a plus.

Benefits and Azion Way of Life

  • CLT hiring model;

  • Health and dental plan;

  • Flexible VR and VA (Flash Card), including during vacation periods;

  • Transport voucher without payroll deduction;

  • Annual internal hackathons;

  • Mobility allowance (additional amount for travel);

  • Freestyle (incentive to customize the workstation);

  • Platform for language courses (English and Spanish);

  • Stock options (according to policy);

  • Birthday day off;

  • TotalPass;

  • Flexible working hours (really flexible);

  • Nomad program to work from anywhere for up to 3 months a year;

  • Annual international exchange program.

FlexWork Model

We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team, but also boosts creativity and innovation.

After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.

Submit your portfolio or include a link to it in your application, so we can get to know your skills and design approach better!

Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!
